verdict.rationale: CrewAI AMP (the paid enterprise tier) advertises a 'Webhook Streaming' feature to 'stream real-time events and updates to your systems', which matches the subscribe-via-webhooks story, but this is gated behind the enterprise product and documentation is a single terse line with no details on event types, payload schema, subscription/registration mechanics, or retry/security semantics. missing for 10: open-source/self-hosted webhook support, detailed docs on event types and payload schema, hands-on/independent confirmation it works as described.
